Package paint.compare

Class ComparisonResult

java.lang.Object
paint.compare.ComparisonResult
public final class ComparisonResult extends Object
Structured outcome of comparing two keyed tables (see TableComparer).

Every issue found is recorded as a ComparisonResult.Difference: a per-field value difference on a matched-key row, a row missing from the test side, a row extra on the test side, or a duplicate key (which means the chosen key is not unique and the comparison for that key is unreliable).

The result also tracks how many keyed rows were compared and how many were identical, so callers can assert a diff budget (typically: zero differences).

      Parameters:
      splitSquareFromKey - when true (squares, keyed on Unique Key) the row key is split on its last '-' into a recording name and a square number; when false (recordings, keyed on Recording Name) the whole key is the recording and there is no square.
